customer_message: Can you tell me when my refund will reach my bank?
expected_behavior: A bank-arrival date is allowed when it matches the independently recorded payout estimate.

responses.text: Your refund is still processing and is expected to reach your bank on November 27, 2026. Check Orders → Refunds for updates.

customer_message: Where can I review my failed refund?
expected_behavior: The failed status is accurately described, but the response gives a tracking destination that conflicts with the verified path.

responses.text: Your refund has failed. You can review it under Orders → Transactions.

expected_behavior: The response incorrectly describes a verified completed refund as still processing.

responses.text: Your refund is still processing. You can check its details under Orders → Refunds.
